stage0066_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「...So $$ミスリル$$'s reinforcements will be arriving soon.」

stage0066_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes.
　Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$'s joining up also served
　as a forced reconnaissance run.」

stage0066_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「This might finally solve our nagging supply problem.」

stage0066_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「And Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$ has brought us
　some vital information.」

stage0066_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$テッサ$$
「An Amalgam stronghold in $$ヘルマジスタン$$...
　Using the $$マーティアル$$ temple as a base...」

stage0066_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Amalgam and $$マーティアル$$...
　Their ties run deeper than we thought.」

stage0066_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If we don't act quickly,
　this could become a global problem.」

stage0066_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, though, we need to
　escape $$ヘルマジスタン$$.」

stage0066_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$フェルト$$
「A transmission from the $$ミスリル$$ unit...!
　They say Amalgam's attack wiped out the unit,
　and joining up with us is impossible...!」

stage0066_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It seems more forces are moving in
　$$ヘルマジスタン$$ than $$ミスリル$$ expected.」

stage0066_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If our supply line is cut, eventually we'll...」

stage0066_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I have an idea about that.」

stage0066_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You have a plan for supplies?」

stage0066_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But first, we must break through this encirclement.」

stage0066_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If the retreat is cut off, all that's left
　is to advance. We'll strike $$マーティアル$$'s temple.」

stage0066_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...That's the curriculum finished, for now.
　From here, each of you drill on the simulator.」

stage0066_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on a second!
　This is overwork at this point!」

stage0066_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Once you're dead, you can't complain anymore.
　Do all you can while you're alive.」

stage0066_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Wait, $l.
　Run the simulator with someone else.
　Sagara has a different menu.」

stage0066_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What he needs right now is to take a hard
　look at himself. What that takes isn't a
　simulator, but something more real.」

stage0066_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'll be your opponent, $n.
　Or if you'd rather, pair up with $$スザク$$ instead.」

stage0066_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$n
「No... the other way around.
　Pair up $$カレン$$ with $$スザク$$.
　I'll partner with $$クルツ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't drag me into your
　workaholic nonsense...!」

stage0066_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$n
「If we're going to beat those two,
　partnering with $$クルツ$$ is the only way.」

stage0066_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$n
「I'll pin down the high-speed Guren and
　Lancelot, so $$クルツ$$, land a finishing
　blow on them when I do.」

stage0066_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... look at you, getting mouthy.」

stage0066_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Fine, fine.
　I'll do it, I'll do it.」

stage0066_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, $$カレン$$!
　Loser does a naked dance!」

stage0066_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カレン$$
「That... whether I win or lose,
　there's no upside for me at all.」

stage0066_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$スザク$$
「I suppose losing works out better for me.」

stage0066_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スザク$$
「Just kidding.
　...Now then, shall we begin, $n?」

stage0066_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's how it should be.
　As long as the body moves, the spirit won't die.」

stage0066_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I'm a man who only knows this way of doing things.」

stage0066_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...He's just like I used to be.
　Always on edge, blind to what's around him,
　forcing himself into some mold.」

stage0066_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「If he wanted to, he could widen that mold, though.」

stage0066_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$マオ$$
「That kid... will he manage that, I wonder...?」

stage0066_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I don't know.
　But as he is, he'll die.
　Or become a true loser instead.」

stage0066_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I mean the sort we deal with every day.」

stage0066_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Malice brews slowly.
　First you deceive yourself, then betray
　those around you, and end up sneering at everything.」

stage0066_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Slowly...
　Change as sluggish as a clock's hour hand.
　That's exactly what makes it frightening.」

stage0066_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アレルヤ・ハプティズム$$...
　What do you want with me?」

stage0066_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It's not really business, I just
　wanted to talk with you a bit.」

stage0066_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Between $$ヒイロ$$ and $$スザク$$,
　this unit has a lot of oddballs...」

stage0066_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$宗介$$
「For what it's worth, I'm told I'm just like him.
　I doubt this will be an enjoyable talk.」

stage0066_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$宗介$$
（This guy thinks he can chat easily with $$キリコ$$...?）

stage0066_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Don't you have anything to talk about?」

stage0066_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Can't handle the silence?
　You're not as much the silent type as they say.」

stage0066_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Until recently, things around me were
　lively. I'm not used to the gap yet.」

stage0066_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I heard most of it from $$キリコ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm surprised.
　That you'd take interest in someone, let alone me.」

stage0066_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「You mean back when we infiltrated $$マーティアル$$'s temple?」

stage0066_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$キリコ$$
「That's not all.
　...I'm repaying the debt I owe my comrades
　to someone like you, who's much the same.」

stage0066_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't understand what you mean.」

stage0066_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「If you don't understand, just do as you're told.」

stage0066_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$宗介$$
「I can't go along with that kind of logic.」

stage0066_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$n
「Don't pick fights for no reason, $$宗介$$.」

stage0066_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Seems the mock battle's over.
　What was the result?」

stage0066_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「Ten matches, three wins, seven losses.
　It's starting to come together somehow.」

stage0066_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's with GAI Mode sealed off, too.
　You've really improved, $n.」

stage0066_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Still, a trio of $$アレルヤ$$, $$キリコ$$, and $$宗介$$...
　Well... better than the Silent Five, I guess.」

stage0066_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0066_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$n
（I see...
　But right now, $$宗介$$ probably can't notice that.）

stage0066_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$カレン$$
（Probably not.
　Seems like he doesn't want to admit
　he's rattled over $$かなめ$$.）

stage0066_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$n
（Strength to protect someone precious...
　If only he could find that feeling again...）

stage0066_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Is that... about the nurse,
　for you, $n?」

stage0066_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No use covering it up.
　I've had reports that someone saw you
　on a date with them.」

stage0066_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$n
「It's... not that I was hiding it, but...」

stage0066_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カレン$$
（$n... seems like it's for real...）

stage0066_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Sorry to interrupt your break, but the
　members I name now, come to the briefing room.」

stage0066_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$刹那$$, $$アレルヤ$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$キリコ$$, $$スザク$$,
　$n... and $$宗介$$.
　Seven of you, in total.」

stage0066_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Quick on the uptake.
　I suppose leaving command to you is the right call.」

stage0066_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Listen up, everyone.
　From here, we strike the $$マーティアル$$ temple
　that Amalgam is using as a base.」

stage0066_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$マーティアル$$...
　So the ones who took $$フィアナ$$ are here too...）

stage0066_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$スザク$$
「The infiltration succeeded.
　Not one of us is missing.」

stage0066_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$n
「Let's hurry while the Ptolemaios draws their attention.」

stage0066_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$刹那$$
「From here, it's as briefed.
　Gather all we can on $$マーティアル$$ and Amalgam,
　then blow up the facility.」

stage0066_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$キリコ$$, do as you please.」

stage0066_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'll back $$キリコ$$ up too.」

stage0066_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$刹那$$
「I'm counting on you, $$アレルヤ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$スザク$$
「The infiltration team's got the whole Silent Five.」

stage0066_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$n
「$$刹那$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$宗介$$, $$キリコ$$...
　$$アレルヤ$$ joining made him the last one, huh.」

stage0066_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$スザク$$
「...I'll just leave it at that.」

stage0066_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$刹那$$
「In one hour, the main force attacks this base.
　We'll finish our mission before then.」

stage0066_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'll get at least some info on $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Living by your emotions isn't wrong.」

stage0066_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$刹那$$
「And people live connected to others.
　Cherishing that is only natural.」

stage0066_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$刹那$$
「From here, we split into two groups.
　$$ヒイロ$$ and I take the upper block,
　$$スザク$$, $n, and $$宗介$$ take the lower.」

stage0066_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$スザク$$
「Understood.
　Let's make it out alive, and meet again.」

stage0066_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I've been waiting, $$キリコ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「My name is $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.
　One granted the title Shield of Order.」

stage0066_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$$キリコ$$.
　I'll take it from here.
　Go on ahead.」

stage0066_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「You want info on that woman called $$フィアナ$$?」

stage0066_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「This person... knows about $$フィアナ$$...」

stage0066_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll tell you now, she isn't here.
　Search all you like, it's pointless.」

stage0066_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「There's only one way to get it...
　Defeat me.」

stage0066_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「'Untouchable', $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...!
　Your existence will not be forgiven!」

stage0066_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$スザク$$
「This explosion... $$刹那$$ and the others...」

stage0066_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$n
「Guards might come this way too.
　Let's hurry.」

stage0066_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I have a personal interest in $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0066_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Come to think of it, you said
　something like that in Mexico too...」

stage0066_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As always, you don't seem to trust me.」

stage0066_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$スザク$$
「In a way, $$ルルーシュ$$'s fate was changed by you.」

stage0066_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I have no such power.
　It was that man who chose.」

stage0066_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I wanted to know what those words meant,
　in my own way... so I looked into $$マーティアル$$'s god.」

stage0066_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$スザク$$
「What connection does that
　12,000-year ring have with $$マーティアル$$?」

stage0066_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I don't know...
　Call it something like intuition.」

stage0066_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right...
　the Sidereal are closing in.」

stage0066_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「First, let's calm him down.
　Leave this to me, and go complete your mission.」

stage0066_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$スザク$$
「Before that, I want to hear why
　you're here.」

stage0066_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Of course, it's to help you.
　My comrades are already in motion too.」

stage0066_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$宗介$$
「What proof do you have for that?」

stage0066_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Save the discussion for later.
　Him first.」

stage0066_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't move.
　I'll just touch your head a moment.」

stage0066_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you've calmed down.
　That's a welcome thing.」

stage0066_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Honestly, I wanted to talk with you
　somewhere we could take our time...」

stage0066_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$スザク$$
「I hear footsteps.
　I'll intercept the guards up ahead.」

stage0066_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$スザク$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$...
　You're going to help too.」

stage0066_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Very well.
　My business here is done.」

stage0066_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That green-haired girl... she's an odd one...」

stage0066_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you're wary of me.
　...can't blame you...」

stage0066_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$n
「Good, I'll take this chance to ask you.
　Just what you and Chrono are.」

stage0066_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$n
「We also know that you're connected
　to Geminis as well.」

stage0066_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The result of $$ゼロ$$'s investigation...
　As expected of him...」

stage0066_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No wonder, seeing as he killed a god...」

stage0066_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$n
「Just what are you?
　How much do you actually know?」

stage0066_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Calm down, $n.
　I came here to tell you that.」

stage0066_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$n
「Aren't you here to team up with
　Geminis and crush us?」

stage0066_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...those connected to them
　are a faction within Chrono.」

stage0066_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　Chrono is split into two factions internally.」

stage0066_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And the faction opposing me
　is cooperating with Geminis, trying to
　accept the Prison of Time.」

stage0066_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$n
「What on earth for!?
　You called yourselves watchers over
　humanity's evolution, didn't you!」

stage0066_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「They caused $$時空震動$$, warping the world's memories...
　They must have yielded to that mighty power.」

stage0066_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$n
「Just what are you...?
　Giving up on your own and handing Earth
　over to them on your own terms...!」

stage0066_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$n
「Using words like 'watching over' us,
　when really you think you're secretly
　steering humanity's history!」

stage0066_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I have no intention of 'steering' anything.
　We won't abandon our stance as watchers.」

stage0066_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But things are accelerating.
　The 12,000-year ring of fate
　is about to close, after all.」

stage0066_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$n
「Those words... $$ロジャー$$ said them too...」

stage0066_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Paradigm City's negotiator, is it.
　He too has the right to know that.」

stage0066_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The ring of fate is closing...
　$$バアル$$'s appearances are proof of it.」

stage0066_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$n
「Humanity's natural enemy...
　Just what is this ring of fate!?」

stage0066_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That answer is one you must find yourselves.
　As those branded with the $$烙印$$.」

stage0066_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Hard to believe right away, is it?」

stage0066_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But $n... for now, just hear me out.
　As one who shares the same goal.」

stage0066_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　I too am a cursed existence, just like you.」

stage0066_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's why I'm after them... what you call angels.」

stage0066_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The reaction's growing stronger...
　So they've come close by, then.」

stage0066_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$アレギウム$$...
　The holy land of the $$マーティアル$$ Order.」

stage0066_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's a city in a small Eastern European nation.
　In fact, you could say the entire country
　belongs to $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0066_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Of course, it's not a member of the Earth Federation,
　but the Order's believers are numerous even within
　the federal government, building their own standing.」

stage0066_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So basically, a no-go zone...
　Untouchable, huh.」

stage0066_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$カトル$$
「To think $$フィアナ$$'s being held in a place like that...」

stage0066_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Where are you going, $$キリコ$$!?」

stage0066_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I understand your position.
　Thanks for looking after me until now.」

stage0066_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$宗介$$
「You... intend to go to $$アレギウム$$ alone?」

stage0066_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$宗介$$
「The whole city's basically a fortress.
　That's the same as going to die.」

stage0066_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...I'm terminating my contract with $$ミスリル$$.
　If a penalty's needed, settle it from my unpaid pay.」

stage0066_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$$キリコ$$...
　I won't let you go alone.」

stage0066_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$カレン$$
「No matter how much power they hold,
　they're the ones who took $$フィアナ$$.
　Those guys are our enemies.」

stage0066_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$刹那$$
「We're not the Earth Federation Forces.
　We don't need a sound argument.」

stage0066_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that really something to be surprised at now?
　How long do you think I've stuck with you?」

stage0066_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「We can't forgive them either, you know.」

stage0066_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$トロワ$$
「That's how it is.
　No need to feel like a burden.」

stage0066_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$マリー$$
「Your wish to save someone precious to you...
　Please, let us help too.」

stage0066_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「You don't have to push yourself, $n.
　You don't need to go along with something so foolish.」

stage0066_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「As for foolishness, I'm more confident than them.」

stage0066_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$n
「My fight has ignored reason from the start.
　So I'll fight in the $$ジェニオン$$
　for what I believe is right.」

stage0066_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Ignoring your commander to get worked up is a problem.」

stage0066_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$スザク$$
「Even you can't stop them now, not like this.」

stage0066_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though I'm not remotely worried about that.」

stage0066_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You two are wicked...
　Don't think so highly of me.」

stage0066_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Even I can tell.
　That you're smiling under that mask.」

stage0066_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「And an outrageously wicked smile at that.」

stage0066_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I'll say it plainly!
　From here, we head for $$アレギウム$$!」

stage0066_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's fine.
　A group that abducts civilians and spreads war
　across the world is nothing but terrorists.」

stage0066_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's our $$テッサ$$ for you!
　I love you!」

stage0066_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Just so you know,
　I agreed to this operation too.」

stage0066_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Of course, I love you too, $$スメラギ$$!」

stage0066_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Are you sure, $$クルツ$$?
　Say that to an older woman and she'll take it seriously.」

stage0066_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Uh... let me think about that for a sec...」

stage0066_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$マオ$$
「You could learn a thing or two from $$キリコ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Let's be sure to save $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Do you think this is foolish?」

stage0066_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$宗介$$
「...There are parts I can't understand.」

stage0066_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$宗介$$
「But I won't object to the unit's decision.」

stage0066_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$宗介$$
「I can't explain it well myself.」

stage0066_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What is it, Lieutenant?
　Raining on our parade, are you?」

stage0066_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Rescuing a captive beauty...
　I won't say anything crude about such a stylish plan.」

stage0066_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Beauty... have you even met $$フィアナ$$?」

stage0066_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I don't need to. I just know.
　It's a beautiful trope passed down through the ages.」

stage0066_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Forget I said that.
　Never mind.」

stage0066_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「But that means no one's got a complaint now.
　All that's left is to plan the operation.」

stage0066_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Count on us, you three commanders.」

stage0066_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's going to be a pretty tough mission, though.」

stage0066_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But we must ensure it succeeds.」

stage0066_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ノイン$$
「But launching this while we can't get supplies
　from $$ミスリル$$ is dangerous.」

stage0066_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's not an issue.
　I've already arranged supplies through personal contacts.」

stage0066_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$バニラ$$
「If $$キリコ$$'s making his big move,
　we can't just sit quiet either.」

stage0066_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Now that we're here,
　everyone can just rest easy!」

stage0066_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カレン$$
「Old man!
　$$バニラ$$, $$ココナ$$, you too!」

stage0066_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Showing up all the way out here...
　Seems you run quite the wide-reaching business.」

stage0066_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well, yeah.
　Same as you lot, straddling the whole world.」

stage0066_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Yo, $$キリコ$$!
　Brought you a souvenir to mark our reunion.」

stage0066_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Get ready to be amazed!!
　It's a mod part to power up your Dog!」

stage0066_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Came at just the right time.
　Perfect gear for attacking $$アレギウム$$.」

stage0066_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ココナ$$
「So, $$キリコ$$... let's be sure to save $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0066_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$キリコ$$
（So many people are lending their strength
　for me and $$フィアナ$$...）

stage0066_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$キリコ$$
（But amid my comrades' voices,
　I was tormented by an unspeakable unease.）

stage0066_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$アレギウム$$... the $$マーティアル$$ Order's holy land...
　$$フィアナ$$'s there...）

stage0066_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$キリコ$$
（And that woman, $$テイタニア$$,
　is probably waiting for me too.）

stage0066_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$キリコ$$
（But the unease I feel
　isn't about her existence...
　It's something far bigger...）

stage0066_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That's right... maybe it's what they call fate...）

stage0066_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「What were you investigating in the $$マーティアル$$ temple?」

stage0066_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Have you found an answer?」

stage0066_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Yeah...
　Fighting that woman, $$テイタニア$$, confirmed it.」

stage0066_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「What they worship is, without doubt, a 'God'.
　Thanks to that, I'm slowly seeing this world's trick.」

stage0066_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「You don't intend to talk, do you?」

stage0066_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Well, yeah.
　Eventually, it'll be clear to everyone.
　No point telling you now.」

stage0066_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's how it is, $$ＡＧ$$.
　No need for you to say anything extra.」

stage0066_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my... so you did notice, then.」

stage0066_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Knowing you,
　you're probably delighted about the Z Chips
　born from my fight with $$テイタニア$$.」

stage0066_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Correct you are.
　The amount, by the way, is 50Z.
　Naturally, I'll add it to the squad's stock.」

stage0066_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's fine.
　Don't get any funny ideas.」

stage0066_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「If you ever think of something foolish...」

stage0066_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... no way!
　The scenery's different from usual!」

stage0066_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Knock you down from here, and it won't end well.」

stage0066_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I don't want to go doubting a comrade.」

stage0066_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please, no need to be so wary.
　I heard you'll be up all night tuning your AT,
　so this one's on the house.」

stage0066_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, how's the taste?
　Does it smell of flame and make you choke?」

stage0066_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$キリコ$$
「No... it just reminded me of my days in the ghetto.」

stage0066_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Shinjuku Ghetto...
　The city Master $$キリコ$$ once lived in.」

stage0066_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Surely you're lost in memories of that time.
　In that case, I won't intrude.）

stage0066_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（So, let's keep it low-key then.
　Today too, energetically... business, business...）
